headings.reviewNote: Places responsibility for device purchase, installation, and maintenance costs on residents, excepting electricity.

headings.title: Safety standards for installation of monitoring devices
headings.reviewNote: Directs devices to be installed safely for room occupants in accordance with department safety regulations.

headings.title: Mandatory placement of monitoring devices in plain view
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronic monitoring devices to be installed and operated in plain view within resident rooms.

headings.title: No facility obligation to provide internet network access
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that facilities are not required to provide internet service or network access for monitoring devices.

headings.title: Room transfers to accommodate electronic monitoring requests
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes facilities to move residents to comparable rooms to accommodate authorized electronic monitoring requests.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.622 governing facility accommodations, entrance notices, costs, safety, and room transfers.

headings.title: Seven-day deemed viewing of footage given for review
headings.reviewNote: Deems a person given monitoring footage by a resident with capacity to review for abuse or neglect to have viewed or listened to it within seven days of receipt for reporting purposes.

headings.title: Viewing prerequisite for mandatory reporting of abuse
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting abuse or neglect based on footage only if the actual abuse or neglect incident is captured on recordings.

headings.title: Duty to provide copy of footage to facility
headings.reviewNote: Requires persons possessing footage of reported abuse or neglect to provide copies to facilities at facility expense.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.624 governing use of monitoring footage for abuse reporting and copies to facilities.

headings.title: Admissibility of electronic monitoring footage in evidence
headings.reviewNote: Provides that monitoring footage is admissible in administrative and court proceedings subject to rules of evidence.

headings.title: Prerequisites for admission of footage into evidence
headings.reviewNote: Precludes admission unless recordings include continuous date and time stamps and unedited continuity.

headings.title: Identification of relevant footage specimens for department
headings.reviewNote: Requires persons submitting multiple recordings to identify specific portions containing evidence of abuse or neglect.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.626 governing admissibility of monitoring footage in legal proceedings, date stamps, and identification.

headings.title: Department sanctions against facility administrators
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes disciplinary sanctions against administrators who knowingly refuse to permit authorized monitoring or retaliate.

headings.title: Administrative civil penalties against noncompliant facilities
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the department to assess administrative penalties against facilities violating authorized monitoring rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.630 governing department sanctions against administrators and administrative penalties against facilities.

headings.title: Criminal misdemeanor penalty for device tampering
headings.reviewNote: Makes intentionally tampering with, obstructing, or destroying monitoring devices or data a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Consent of resident or guardian as affirmative defense
headings.reviewNote: Establishes resident or guardian consent as an affirmative defense to criminal device tampering prosecutions.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for continuing unauthorized monitoring
headings.reviewNote: Classifies placing unauthorized monitoring devices or refusing to remove them after notice as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.632 governing criminal penalties for device tampering, affirmative defenses, and unauthorized placement.

headings.title: Annual registration requirement for supplemental agencies
headings.reviewNote: Requires persons operating supplemental health care services agencies to register annually for each business location.

headings.title: Application contents and controlling person disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Directs application submissions disclosing controlling persons, corporate officers, ownership shares, and addresses.

headings.title: One-year registration term and non-transferability
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a one-year registration term and voids registrations upon transfer of agency ownership or management.

headings.title: Department oversight through unannounced annual surveys
headings.reviewNote: Charges the department with agency oversight through annual unannounced surveys and complaint investigations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.642 governing supplemental health care services agency registration, fees, terms, and department oversight.

headings.title: Minimum operational criteria for registered agencies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes ten minimum registration criteria including credential verification, background checks, malpractice and workers' compensation/occupational accident insurance, quarterly charge/pay reports, ten-year record retention, and facility indemnification capped at $100,000 for federal civil penalties.

headings.title: Revocation or nonrenewal for statutory noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Subjects supplemental agencies failing to comply with statutory standards to registration revocation or nonrenewal.

headings.title: Mandatory revocation for supplying fraudulent credentials
headings.reviewNote: Mandates registration revocation upon fifteen days' advance written notice for knowingly supplying personnel with illegally or fraudulently obtained credentials or background studies.

headings.title: Appeal of registration revocation to hearing commission
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes agencies and controlling persons to appeal registration suspensions or revocations to the administrative hearing commission.

headings.title: Five-year debarment for controlling persons of revoked agencies
headings.reviewNote: Bars controlling persons of revoked or nonrenewed agencies from registering or operating any agency for five years.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 198.644 governing supplemental agency minimum criteria, fraudulent credentials, revocation, and debarment.
